domain: Hospitality / Event Operations (weddings, funerals, majalis, meetings, meals, events in the Sultanate of Oman) — NOT property management.
description: Canonical Database Contract — machine-readable invariants the Database Guardian enforces. Human-readable companion: guardian/README.md and guardian/contract/business-invariants.md. CRITICAL/HIGH violations block the portable release gate and block CI when the Guardian workflow is installed.

money.rule: Every money column MUST be an exact NUMERIC with scale 3. Unit prices and rates use numeric(12,3); derived totals (sums/products of unit prices × quantities) may use numeric(14,3). The invariant that must never break: scale 3, never binary float, never narrower than numeric(12,3) for a unit price.
money.notes: AGENTS.md and this contract use numeric(12,3) for unit prices/rates and allow numeric(14,3) for derived totals. Both are exact NUMERIC with OMR scale 3; binary float is banned for persisted money.

event.transitionRule: Status moves only through transition_event_status() which enforces the documented matrix; CANCELLED is reached exclusively via cancel_event(); CLOSED is blocked while equipment or consumables are outstanding; DISPATCH requires readiness (READY or an audited override via event_transition_overrides).

quotation.transitionRule: A DRAFT is editable via update_quotation_draft(); once ISSUED the commercial snapshot is immutable except for documented lifecycle metadata; acceptance converts the event to CONFIRMED; a revision supersedes prior ISSUED quotations of the same event. quotation_lines are immutable for non-DRAFT quotations (protect_quotation_snapshot / prevent_quotation_line_mutation triggers).

attendance.transitionRule: Earned amounts derive from wage_method/wage_rate and check-in/out via compute_earned_amount(); attendance rows are append-only except the documented void transition; clock in/out pairs are enforced.

equipment.transitionRule: Ledger movements are append-only (warehouse_ledger_is_append_only); reconciliation is append-only; a CLOSED event must have zero outstanding equipment.

consumables.transitionRule: Movements are append-only (consumable_ledger_guard); stock on hand is a derivation over the ledger; a CLOSED event must have zero outstanding consumables.

procurement.transitionRule: History-guarded (procurement_order_history_guard); receipt lines append-only; suppliers are master data that cannot be hard-deleted; orders are scoped to an event when provided.

immutableTransitions.invoices: ISSUED → CANCELLED only (invoice_guard); all financial fields immutable after issue
immutableTransitions.event_expenses: RECORDED → VOIDED only; financial/source fields are immutable and VOID audit metadata is write-once (event_expenses_append_only_guard, Guardian 0078 + 0079)

security.secdefAcl: authenticated-only EXECUTE for RPCs; internal-only for trigger helpers; anon EXECUTE forbidden
security.searchPathPinned: SET search_path TO '' (or explicit pinned path) on every SECURITY DEFINER function
security.clientDeleteForbidden: No DELETE RLS policy on financial or master-catalog tables; DELETE allowed only on explicitly listed tables and bounded by FKs
security.costDataSeparation: cost_price / internal_notes and financial ledgers readable only by OWNER/MANAGER/ACCOUNTANT (can_read_cost), enforced at the data boundary, not just the UI

writePaths.notes: Allowed direct client writes mirror the RLS policies that exist today (extracted from the schema). Any new direct client write outside this list is a finding. DELETE is never allowed on financial or master-catalog tables. Event state changes, quotations, invoices, payments, expenses, closures, procurement, attendance, consumables and equipment movements are command-only (SECURITY DEFINER RPCs).
